what_it_is.prose: Dhruva Space is a Hyderabad-based full-stack space engineering solutions company founded in 2012 by Sanjay Nekkanti (CEO). Specialises in small satellites, satellite orbital deployers and hosted payload platforms. Successfully space-qualified its Satellite Orbital Deployer (DSOD-1U) aboard ISRO's PSLV-C53 mission on 30 June 2022 — first private Indian deployer space qualification. Followed up with DSOL (orbital link), DSOD-3U and DSOD-6U deployers aboard PSLV-C55 on 22 April 2023. LEAP-TD (Launch Embedding Agnostic Payload Testbed) hosted-payload platform successfully demonstrated on ISRO's PSLV-C58 / POEM-3 mission (Jan 2024) — declares Dhruva open for hosted payload business. Compatible with PSLV and other launch vehicles; supports up to 16U payload volume.

LEAP-TD (Launch Embedding Agnostic Payload Testbed): hosted payload platform for in-orbit experiments; successful demo on POEM-3 (Jan 2024)
Small satellite platforms (commercial, governmental, academic markets) up to 16U payload volume
Earth stations and ground segment solutions
